name: Bjørn Arnesen
bio:
Bjørn Arnesen's career has been a steady climb through the ranks of security, a field he entered after serving in the Norwegian military police. His no-nonsense approach and meticulous attention to detail quickly made him a sought-after asset for high-profile events. Motorsport came calling after a chance encounter with a team owner at a security convention. Impressed by Bjørn's rigorous methods, he was offered the position of security chief, a role he relishes for its complex challenges and high stakes. 

Bjørn views security as a proactive endeavor, emphasizing preventative measures and threat assessment over reactive responses. His focus is on building robust systems that minimize risk, fostering a culture of vigilance within the team. Known for his unwavering loyalty and quiet intensity, Bjørn is the watchful guardian of Hot Racing Team, ensuring their safety and operational integrity.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back, receding hairline
physical.description: A sturdy man with a serious demeanor, Bjørn projects an aura of quiet authority.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn notebook filled with security protocols and risk assessments.
Has a habit of meticulously cleaning his glasses, even when they appear spotless.
Insists on personally inspecting every entry and exit point before each event.
